events.title: Intrigue Chocolate Tasting Class
events.description: Intrigue Chocolate Tasting Class 📅 Date: November 12 ⏰ Time: 5:00-7:30pm 💵 Price: $48 (+ $2 processing fee) 🎟️ Register online: Click here! Indulge your sweet tooth with a 1-hour tasting and education session with local chocolate makers! During this class, you’ll delve into the science of flavor, gain insight into the chocolate-making process, and taste your way through various chocolate products (cacao tea, roasted cacao beans, and six different chocolate bars) with Aaron Barthel and Karl Mueller, co-owners of Intrigue Chocolate in downtown Chisholm, MN. 🍫☕🤤 About Aaron: Raised in Minnesota, Aaron has worn many hats throughout his life—he’s been a farmer, a botanist, a brewer, a baker, a chef, and a chocolate maker. He’s passionate about small-batch craft chocolate, and he loves experimenting with fruits, herbs, and spices. About Karl: Karl has an entrepreneurial spirit dedicated to taking on what he describes as the ultimate career challenge—building a sustainable and ethical business in the notoriously difficult industry of craft chocolate. He’s also interested in history, culture, and generally making the world a better place. Event Schedule: 🍸 5:00pm—Arrive, mingle, sip cocktails and mocktails 👨🏻‍🏫 5:30pm—Class starts 👏 6:30pm—Class ends 💸 7:00pm—Grab another drink, peruse additional chocolate merch 👋 7:30pm—Say goodbye to Aaron and Karl; take some time to explore the Museum before MDC closes Special note: Museum admission is always free from 4:00-8:00pm on Thursdays, so you can explore the exhibits and grounds before/after the class. There will also be a cash bar and extra snacks for purchase!

events.description: The Orchard Pack is our newest limited variety pack, and you can be the first to try it in the taproom this Friday before it hits stores. Inside, you’ll find three of each: Caramel Apple Fresh apple layered with rich caramel for a sweet, easy-drinking cider. Peach Cobbler Ripe peach and fresh apple with warm cobbler-inspired spices. Cider Donut Crisp, semi-sweet cider with cinnamon. Apple Pie Slushies will be back, DJ Walt Dizzo will be playing from 7–9 pm, and Wrecktangle will have their secret menu item, the Crouching Tiger, a grilled peach pizza with bacon, fresh jalapeño, parmesan, and basil.

events.description: Join Ingrid for a relaxing Mandala Rock Painting class. Guests can bring their own rocks or choose from Ingrid’s collection of hand-picked rocks. events.title: Duluth Plant Swap
events.description: On the last Monday of every month, the taproom turns into a plant market! Buy, sell, swap, or browse. Whether you’re hunting for your next houseplant, looking to trade cuttings, or clearing some space on your plant shelf, this is the place. You’ll find houseplants, gemstones, and other plant-related handmade goods. No plants? No problem. You’re welcome to stop by, shop, and hang out. If you’re bringing plants to sell or swap, please make sure they are: Healthy Pest-free Rooted, or if unrooted, have visible nodes Please label your plants with the proper names to the best of your ability (common or scientific!) Priced, or have a price in mind if you’d rather sell than trade

events.title: Gilmore Girls Cookie Decorating Class
events.description: Join us Tuesday, September 29, from 6–8 PM for a Gilmore Girls cookie decorating class with Frosted Sweets by Jessica. You’ll decorate eight cookies inspired by the show, with plenty of Stars Hollow references along the way. Jessica will walk you through the decorating process, so you don’t need to be a cookie decorating pro to join in. Bring your fellow Gilmore Girls fan, grab a cider, and settle in for a couple of hours of cookie decorating. Tickets are available through Frosted Sweets by Jessica.

events.description: Join Jordan Larson on Sunday, October 11 at 2 PM in the taproom for an afternoon of watercolor painting. events.title: Baptism River Barbecue Co.
events.description: Get ready for some seriously good Northwoods barbecue! Baptism River Barbecue Co. is rolling up to the Castle Danger Brewery taproom throughout 2026, serving their signature smoked meats and scratch-made sides crafted with locally sourced produce, responsibly raised animals, and hardwoods grown along Lake Superior’s North Shore. Founded by husband-and-wife team Dan and Kaylee Cahill Mathews, Baptism River Barbecue Co. brings a warm, community-focused vibe and unforgettable flavors to every visit. Whether you’re craving melt-in-your-mouth brisket, perfectly smoked pulled pork, or hearty homemade sides, their menu delivers comfort, craft, and true North Shore character. Come hungry, grab a pint, and enjoy some of the best barbecue around—right here on the harbor.. Follow them: Website: baptismriverbbq.com Instagram: @baptismriver_barbecueco Facebook: Baptism River Barbecue Co.

events.title: HECK OF THE NORTH & CASTLE DANGER BREWERY PRESENT: CHARLIE PARR
events.description: HECK FEST ABOUT HECK FEST After conquering the gravel roads of Minnesota’s North Shore, join us in downtown Two Harbors for the inaugural Heck Fest, the official post-race celebration of the Heck of the North. Enjoy food trucks, fresh Castle Danger beer, and the camaraderie that makes the Heck of the North community so special. We’re also thrilled to welcome acclaimed Minnesota musician Charlie Parr for a special live performance at 4:00 PM. A longtime favorite of Heck of the North, Charlie’s authentic blend of folk, blues, and Americana provides the perfect soundtrack for an afternoon of celebrating riders, volunteers, and another unforgettable day on the bike. Open to riders, supporters, and the public. Free to attend. ABOUT CHARLIE PARR In the music of Charlie Parr, there is a sincere conviction and earnest drive to create. The Minnesota-born guitarist, songwriter, and interpreter of traditional music has released 19 albums over two decades and has been known to perform up to 275 shows a year. Parr is a folk troubadour in the truest sense: taking to the road between shows, writing and rewriting songs as he plays, fueled by a belief that music is eternal and cannot be claimed or adequately explained. The bluesman poet pulls closely from the sights and sounds around him, his lyrical craftsmanship built by his influences. The sounds from his working-class upbringing—including Folkways legends such as Lead Belly and Woody Guthrie—imbue Parr’s music with stylistic echoes of blues and folk icons of decades past. Parr sees himself merely as a continuer of a folk tradition: “I feel like I stand on a lot of big shoulders,” he said in an interview. “I hope that I’ve brought a little bit of myself to the music.” With a discography simultaneously transcendental in nature and grounded in roots music, Charlie Parr is the humble master of the 21st century folk tradition. events.title: Baptism River Barbecue Co.
events.description: Get ready for some seriously good Northwoods barbecue! Baptism River Barbecue Co. is rolling up to the Castle Danger Brewery taproom throughout 2026, serving their signature smoked meats and scratch-made sides crafted with locally sourced produce, responsibly raised animals, and hardwoods grown along Lake Superior’s North Shore. Founded by husband-and-wife team Dan and Kaylee Cahill Mathews, Baptism River Barbecue Co. brings a warm, community-focused vibe and unforgettable flavors to every visit. Whether you’re craving melt-in-your-mouth brisket, perfectly smoked pulled pork, or hearty homemade sides, their menu delivers comfort, craft, and true North Shore character. Come hungry, grab a pint, and enjoy some of the best barbecue around—right here on the harbor.. Follow them: Website: baptismriverbbq.com Instagram: @baptismriver_barbecueco Facebook: Baptism River Barbecue Co.

events.title: Fresh Hop Fest
events.description: Fresh Hop Fest Saturday, October 17 | 11:00 AM–6:00 PM Celebrate hop harvest season with us at the taproom! Fresh Hop Fest is a full day of fresh beer, live music, food, and fall fun. We’ll be pouring taproom-only fresh hop beer releases, brewed with freshly harvested hops to capture bright, vibrant hop flavors at their peak. Fresh Hop Beer Enjoy exclusive, taproom-only fresh hop releases throughout the day. Live Music All Day 11:00 AM–1:00 PM | Northeast Timberland Band 1:30–3:30 PM | Shorething 4:00–6:00 PM | Squid City Slingers Food Baptism River Barbecue will be serving up the goods throughout the event. Fall Fun Gourd Painting Get creative with a fall favorite. Hop Education Learn more about hops, the harvest, and what makes fresh hop beer unique. Hop Trivia Put your hop knowledge to the test!

events.title: Live Music: North East Timberland Band
events.description: The Northeast Timberland Band has been making music across the Duluth area for more than a decade, blending bluegrass, country rock, easy-listening classics, and modern acoustic favorites into an engaging live performance. Known for their rich three-part harmonies and tight instrumentation, the band delivers a balanced mix of original songs and familiar covers that audiences know and love

events.title: Live Music: Squid City Slingers
events.description: Squid City Slingers are a high-energy Minnesota trio blending bluegrass, folk, country, and gypsy jazz into a sound that’s equal parts foot-stomping and heartfelt. Featuring driving stand-up bass, fiery fiddle, and flat-picking guitar, the band has built a growing following across the Twin Cities and Twin Ports through a mix of rich harmonies, original songs, and carefully selected covers. The group has performed at venues and festivals across the Midwest including Bent Paddle, Earth Rider, Gunflint Tavern, Bluegrass on the Black Festival, SquidFest, and the Minnesota Musician Showcase at Mall of America. With appearances on regional radio, television, podcasts, and an expanding festival schedule, Squid City Slingers continue to establish themselves as one of the Midwest’s rising acoustic acts. Their EP, Harbors & Highways, showcases the band’s Northwoods-inspired songwriting and energetic live sound.

From 6-8pm, bring the book you are currently reading and chat with fellow book lovers. No specific genre, no specific title. Anything you are reading! Every book lover who brings their book to chat about will receive $1 off your first beer!

events.title: Double-Points for Loyalty Members
events.description: Taproom Loyalty members will receive double-points for their purchases on Wednesdays. Beers, a t-shirt from the merch store, another beer, a growler of your favorite beer to go, all double-points on Wednesdays. Not a Taproom Loyalty member? Join on your next trip to the brewery or sign up here.

events.title: Castle Danger Game Night
events.description: Castle Danger Game Nights Every Wednesday | 5:00 – 8:30pm Looking for a fun and welcoming way to spend your Wednesday evenings? Join us at Castle Danger Brewery for Game Nights. Game Nights bring people together to laugh, relax, and share good company over a table of cards, boards, or dice. Our taproom game collection will be open for everyone to use, ranging from classics to modern favorites. Guests are also encouraged to bring their own games to share with the group. Whether you’re coming with friends or flying solo, there’s always a place at the table. Game Nights are all about connection, laughter, and a relaxed community vibe, paired with your favorite Castle Danger beer. Come as you are, stay as long as you’d like, and let’s play!

events.title: Meat Raffle
events.description: Meat Raffle at Castle Danger Brewery Get ready for a true Minnesota classic. Join us in the taproom for an evening of cold beer, friendly competition, and community fun at our Meat Raffle, hosted by Two Harbors Moose Lodge 1463, featuring premium cuts from Zup’s Meat Market. Grab your tickets, gather your crew, and take your shot at winning some top-notch meats from Zup’s —all while supporting a great cause. All proceeds benefit the Moose Lodge and the local organizations they serve right here in the Two Harbors community. Event Details: $2 Tickets | 30 Tickets per board $40 Prize Packs 6:00 pm Start

events.title: Art on Tap With Eric Klepinger
events.description: Join us for another fun and creative evening of Art on Tap at Castle Danger Brewery! Each class is led by professional artist and Voyageur Artists member Eric Klepinger. Every session features a new theme and painting style — perfect for both beginners and experienced artists looking to relax, create, and enjoy a cold beer while they paint. Class is $15 for Voyageur Members/$20 for non-members Class is limited to 24 participants, no experience necessary and all the materials will be supplied.

events.title: Slow Flow + Sip Yoga with Lake Effect Yoga
events.description: Slow Flow + Sip Yoga with Lake Effect Yoga Last Sunday of Every Month | Castle Danger Brewery Taproom Unwind and reset with Slow Flow + Sip Yoga, led by Stacy Nightwine of Lake Effect Yoga. This monthly class combines gentle, mindful movement with a laid-back brewery vibe, perfect for all levels of yogis. When the weather allows, we’ll take the flow outside to our scenic patio overlooking Lake Superior. Please bring your own mat and come ready to relax, breathe, and move at your own pace. $20 per person Includes one complimentary short draught pour Stacy, a North Shore local, is passionate about helping others reconnect with their bodies and minds through yoga and mindfulness. She looks forward to sharing her love of practice—and good beer—with you. Click the link below to reserve your spot!

events.title: Bizhiki
events.description: Bizhiki presents a multidisciplinary performance aiming to educate, engage, and empower audiences – specifically youth and families – around contemporary Ojibwe culture and lifeways. The project makes great efforts to both support revitalization within Tribal communities andenhance understanding in non-Tribal communities.The music of Bizhiki blends the ethereal vocals and visceral drumming of Dylan Bizhikiins Jennings (Bad River Ojibwe) and Joe Rainey Sr. (Red Lake Ojibwe) with contemporary soundscape multi-instrumentalist, songwriter, and producer S. Carey. Connecting the songs is a lyrical narrative inwhich Jennings and Rainey share pieces of the Anishinaabe experience around identity, loss, and revitalization. The visual backdrop, created by filmmaker Finn Ryan, grounds and contextualizes the music and lyrics connecting with audiences in a culturally relevant way while building off oftheir own prior experiences with Indigenous culture and art.The talented performers’ diverse instrumentation - including powwow drums, percussion, drum programming, electric bass, synthesizers, guitars, piano, and vocals - expertly evoke the lived Anishinaabe experience in a unique format. Audiences are welcomed to gather in intimate community to connect experientially and emotionally to Ojibwe culture, all through the crisp lens of art and collaboration.The live performance element features music from an 11 track album by the longtime collaborators, intermixed with compelling video background, striking lighting, and powerful sound design, creating a cohesive and moving live performance. The group also threads in classic Ojibwe storytelling, opportunities for curiosity and reflection, and digestible details so that audiences will leave the experience feeling intellectually, spiritually, and culturally nourished.

events.title: Brother Ali with DJ Abilities
events.description: Brother Ali is a respected Hip Hop artist, speaker, and community leader. His two-decade resume includes ten critically-acclaimed albums, mentorships with iconic Hip Hop legends Chuck D and Rakim, and performances on late night shows with Jimmy Fallon and Conan O’Brien.His provocative and uplifting brand of Hip Hop has earned him coveted press features like Rolling Stone’s 40th anniversary edition and Source Magazine’s “Hip Hop Quotables”, while his outspoken social justice message has landed him on government watch lists. He’s also lectured at universities from Princeton to Stanford and delivered the keynote address at the Nobel Peace Prize Forum.When he’s not rocking the mic at Coachella or being arrested for civil disobedience in support of marginalized communities, Brother Ali travels the world learning and teaching Islamic Spirituality under some of today’s most renowned teachers. In addition to leading worship services and classes, he co-founded The Gemali Project, an organization that helps Muslim converts and spiritual seekers access the beauty of the Islamic tradition. Brother Ali recently launched The Travelers Podcast from his new home in Istanbul, exploring life’s journey with cultural, spiritual, and thought leaders from across the globe.

events.title: Charlie Parr
events.description: LISTEN HEREIn the music of Charlie Parr, there is a sincere conviction and earnest drive to create. The Minnesota-born guitarist, songwriter, and interpreter of traditional music has released 19 albums over two decades and has been known to perform up to 275 shows a year. Parr is a folk troubadour in the truest sense: taking to the road between shows, writing and rewriting songs as he plays, fueled by a belief that music is eternal and cannot be claimed or adequately explained. The bluesman poet pulls closely from the sights and sounds around him, his lyrical craftsmanship built by his influences. The sounds from his working-class upbringing—including Folkways legends such as Lead Belly and Woody Guthrie—imbue Parr’s music with stylistic echoes of blues and folk icons of decades past. Parr sees himself merely as a continuer of a folk tradition: “I feel like I stand on a lot of big shoulders,” he said in an interview. “I hope that I’ve brought a little bit of myself to the music.”

events.title: Sound & Lights Production for the Working Musician
events.description: Great performances don't happen by accident. They happen through thoughtful planning, the right equipment, and a professional approach to live production. Join Willow Pit Production for an inside look at what it takes to produce successful live events—from intimate bar gigs to full-scale festival stages like Big Top Chautauqua.This workshop will pull back the curtain on the world of live sound and lighting, giving local musicians a behind-the-scenes look at how professional productions come together.Topics include:- Sound and lighting essentials for live performance Equipment needs for venues of all sizes- Working effectively with sound engineers and production crews- Stage setup, planning, and show flowWhether you're just starting to perform or looking to elevate your live shows, this workshop offers practical knowledge that will help you communicate more effectively, perform with confidence, and deliver a better experience for your audience.

events.title: The Wallflowers
events.description: Listen Here!The Wallflowers will mark the 30th anniversary of their landmark album Bringing Down the Horse with a nationwide U.S. tour kicking off April 17, 2026. The band will perform their classic album in its entirety, in sequence. The tour will also include a performance at Stagecoach, the world’s largest country music festival.Originally released on May 21, 1996, Bringing Down the Horse was a critical and commercial triumph. The album peaked at number four on the Billboard 200 and was certified quadruple platinum, cementing the band’s place in ‘90s rock history.The LP yielded four hit singles:• “6th Avenue Heartache” – Two GRAMMY nominations (1997)• “One Headlight” – Reached #1 on the Billboard singles chart, winning two GRAMMY Awards (1998). The song ranked #58 on Rolling Stone’s “100 Greatest Pop Songs”• “The Difference” – GRAMMY nomination (1998)• “Three Marlenas” – Released as the album’s final single in October 1997Influenced by a slew of first-generation American songwriters including The Band and Tom Petty & the Heartbreakers, The Wallflowers will also pay tribute on the upcoming tour to the 50th anniversary of Tom Petty & the Heartbreakers’ by playing Petty’s 1982 album, Long After Dark, in its entirety and in sequence as well.Jakob Dylan, the band’s chief songwriter, remains a vital performer in American rock music. As part of three decades of work, in 2002, he inducted Tom Petty into the Rock n Roll Hall of Fame. In 2018, he performed in the critically acclaimed documentary Echo in the Canyon, collaborating with artists ranging from Neil Young and Eric Clapton to Beck, Cat Power, Norah Jones, Regina Spektor.Dylan also contributed songs to several soundtracks, including The Wallflowers' cover of "Heroes" for the 1998 Godzilla film soundtrack and "Arms of a Ghost" to television series, NCIS Los Angeles and "Nothing But the Whole Wide World" to Friday Night Lights. events.title: Trampled By Turtles
events.description: Trampled by Turtles are from Duluth, Minnesota, where frontman Dave Simonett initially formed the group as a side project in 2003. At the time, Simonett had lost most of his music gear, thanks to a group of enterprising car thieves who'd ransacked his vehicle while he played a show with his previous band. Left with nothing more than an acoustic guitar, he began piecing together a new band, this time taking inspiration from bluegrass, folk, and other genres that didn't rely on amplification. Simonett hadn't played any bluegrass music before, and he filled his lineup with other newcomers to the genre, including fiddler Ryan Young (who'd previously played drums in a speed metal act) and bassist Tim Saxhaug. Along with mandolinist Erik Berry and banjo player Dave Carroll, the group began carving out a fast, frenetic sound that owed as much to rock & roll as bluegrass. There crossover appeal has landed them on the #1 spot of Billboard’s Bluegrass Charts on every record they’ve released while playing marquee festivals like Coachella, ACL Fest, and Lollapalooza. Countless tours with diverse artists ranging Shakey Graves, Zach Bryan, Wilco, Caamp, Mt Joy, Willie Nelson, Avett Brothers, Lord Huron and many more have followed solidifying a loyal fanbase. Their last full length album Alpenglow was produced by Wilco’s Jeff Tweedy. 2025 began with the band releasing a cover of Bon Iver’s “From Emma” with Caamp’s Taylor Meier (aka Sumbuck) on lead vocals. A few new collaborations are set to be announced in the coming weeks.Sponsored By:Madeline Island VacationsPerfect Duluth DayKylmala TrussWXPR
